name: Beijing Haitian Ruisheng Science Technology Ltd.
summary: Beijing Haitian Ruisheng Science Technology Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in research and development, design, production, and sales of AI training data in China and internationally. The company offers speech recognition, speech synthesis, natural language processing, computer vision, and dictionary datasets for IT internet, intelligent search and driving, social media, educational research, smart home, smart security, smart finance, and smart city applications.
